 SSC CPO Paper 2 Exam 2026: What Should Candidates Do Next? 
 SSC CPO Paper 2 Exam Date 2026 (Out): The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has officially announced the SSC CPO Paper 2 Exam Date 2026. As per the latest examination schedule, the Paper-II Computer-Based Examination (CBE) for the Sub-Inspector in Delhi Police and CAPFs Examination, 2025, will be conducted on 28 November 2026. Candidates who have qualified for the second paper should check the examination schedule and keep track of upcoming updates regarding the city intimation slip and admit card.
 SSC CPO Paper 2 Exam Date 2026: Latest Update
 The Staff Selection Commission has released an official notice dated 2 November 2026, confirming the examination date for SSC CPO Paper-II. According to the notification (Ref. No. F.No. HQ-EC033/7/2025-EC), the examination will take place on 28 November 2026 in Computer-Based Examination (CBE) mode.
 The examination is part of the Sub-Inspector in Delhi Police and CAPFs Examination, 2025. Candidates should check the official SSC website regularly for further announcements, including examination city details, admit cards, and other important instructions.

 SSC CPO Paper 2 Exam 2026: What Should Candidates Do Next?
 With the Paper-II examination date confirmed, candidates should focus on their final preparation and keep track of upcoming examination-related announcements. Here are a few important steps to follow:
 Continue exam preparation: Revise important topics and practise questions regularly to improve accuracy and time management.
 Practise previous year papers : Solve the SSC CPO 2020 Question Paper to understand the question pattern and previous examination trends.
 Check the city intimation slip: Keep checking the official website for details about the allotted examination city.
 Download the admit card: Once released, download the admit card and verify your examination date, centre, and reporting time.
 Follow official instructions: Read all examination guidelines carefully before appearing for the Computer-Based Examination.
 SSC CPO Paper 2 Exam Date 2026 FAQs
 Q1. When will the SSC CPO Paper 2 Exam 2026 be conducted?
 The SSC CPO Paper 2 Exam 2026 is scheduled to be conducted on 28 November 2026 in Computer-Based Examination (CBE) mode. Q2. When was the SSC CPO Paper 2 Exam Date 2026 announced?
 The Staff Selection Commission announced the SSC CPO Paper-II exam date through an official notice released on 2 November 2026. Q3. When will the SSC CPO Paper 2 Admit Card 2026 be released?
 The SSC CPO Paper 2 Admit Card 2026 release date has not been announced yet. Candidates should visit the official SSC website for the latest updates. Q4. Where can candidates check the SSC CPO Paper 2 Exam Schedule 2026?
